items.title: Re-vendor LibKa0s v1.71.0 (kit 38) from the local tag; record the unrecorded v1.69.0/v1.70.0 re-vendors in a span bundle; de-tag stale v1.68.1 stamps
items.spec: Follow /dev-copilot:wow-revendor-libka0s mechanically (OWNER_SCOPE 5: no interview, no issue filing). Source is ../LibKa0s at the LOCAL tag v1.71.0 (git -C ../LibKa0s archive or worktree of the tag, never the feature-branch HEAD if it moved). Copy libs/LibKa0s/ and tests/_kit/ whole from the tag's LibKa0s/ and testkit/. CLAUDE.md provenance line 'Bundles [LibKa0s](...) v1.70.0 (MIT).' becomes v1.71.0 in the same commit; tests/test_vendor_sync.lua passes against the tag. Kit 38 changes the --list Totals table (LK-01): regenerate docs/test-cases.md (`lua tests/run.lua --list`, CRLF) and set the README tests badge to the new Total in the same commit. Write docs/revendor/2026-10-07-v1.71.0/ (01_DELTA.md line 1 'Delta: LibKa0s v1.70.0 -> v1.71.0', per-file LibStub minors, kit 37->38 pairing; 02_CANDIDATES.md listing new surfaces: Kit.secret/Kit.installSecretValue (adopted later by WG-01, recorded as 'adopted in this run by WG-01'), WidgetsLineChart minor 3 / ChartMath.ClipSegment, WidgetsAutocomplete minor 2, Slash key 20.2, Env minor 2, OptionsIdList minor 4 each 'not adopted in this run' unless WhatGroup consumes the major, in which case 'carried by re-vendor, no code change'; 03_DECISIONS.md; 05_SUMMARY.md). ALSO write the consolidated span bundle docs/revendor/2026-10-07-v1.69.0-v1.70.0/ for commits 9677d99 (v1.69.0, kit 37) and 3fd8a2f (v1.70.0): 01_DELTA.md line 1 exactly 'Delta: LibKa0s v1.69.0 -> v1.70.0 (span: v1.69.0 v1.70.0)' with base v1.68.1 stated in the body, recording WidgetsLineChart.lua, WidgetsAutocomplete.lua and kit 37 mock_lines.lua; 05_SUMMARY.md one line per tag 'carried by sweep, nothing adopted'. The AUDIT.md tag-vs-recorded check (tags from CLAUDE.md horizon vs bundles) then prints nothing. Same commit: docs/testing.md:291 drops the hard 'v1.68.1' (refer to the tag on the CLAUDE.md provenance line); docs/debug.md:18 and docs/debug-content.md:8 name only the DebugLog minor (or point at the CLAUDE.md provenance line) instead of 'vendored from v1.68.1'. Never edit libs/ or tests/_kit/ beyond the copy.

3. `lua tests/run.lua` (vendor gate green); regenerate docs/test-cases.md and the README badge.
4. Write docs/revendor/2026-10-07-v1.69.0-v1.70.0/ and docs/revendor/2026-10-07-v1.71.0/.
5. Reword docs/testing.md:291, docs/debug.md:18, docs/debug-content.md:8.

items.title: Teleport-cooldown reader survives secret cooldown values: unknown instead of a raise, ticker stays armed; regression cases on Kit.secret
items.spec: core/Compat.lua: add Compat.IsSecret (the library's LibKa0s-Compat IsSecret when present, else the three-line issecretvalue stub per anti-pattern #47: `return issecretvalue ~= nil and issecretvalue(v) or false`). Compat.GetSpellCooldownRemaining(spellID) also takes isActive from the library reader (the 5th/active flag of the cooldown info; if the library's GetSpellCooldown does not surface it, read it from the same table inside the shim). When start or duration is secret it does NO comparison or arithmetic and returns nil, isActive (an 'unknown' signal); it never returns 0 for a secret reading (0 would report an on-cooldown teleport as READY). Plain readings keep today's contract (number >= 0, GCD floor). Update the docstring. Callers: core/WhatGroup.lua teleportValue (:828) tags '(on cooldown)' when remaining > 0 OR (remaining == nil and isActive); omits the tag when unknown and not active. modules/Frame.lua :639 (button state) treats nil-with-isActive as on cooldown (renders the cooldown state with no countdown figure) and nil-without as ready; the ticker callback (:588) on a nil reading keeps the last rendered text and returns (stays armed), never stopping or reconfiguring. GetSpellCooldownTimes (swipe) passes secret values straight to Cooldown:SetCooldown unchanged (widgets accept secrets) — document that in its comment; do not compare them. modules/Diagnostics.lua:21 comment updated to name the new guard. Tests use the re-vendored kit: Kit.secret and Kit.installSecretValue (restore in teardown); the GetSpellCooldown mock in tests/wow_mock.lua gains a way to return a table whose startTime/duration are Kit.secret wrappers while isActive stays plain. docs/compat-layer.md and docs/module-map.md get one-line notes on the secret arm; regenerate docs/test-cases.md and the README badge in the same commit.
items.steps:
1. Red first: tests/test_compat.lua: with issecretvalue installed and a secret start/duration, GetSpellCooldownRemaining does not raise and returns nil, true (`-- red under: the unguarded start <= 0 compare`). tests/test_frame.lua (or the ticker's suite): popup shown with a ticking cooldown, then the mock flips to secret values, advance the timer: no error, ticker handle still live, note text unchanged (`-- red under:` the ticker dying). Optional tests/test_notify case: ShowNotification with a secret cooldown prints the Teleport row with '(on cooldown)' and ShowFrame still runs. Run `lua tests/run.lua`: red.
2. Implement Compat.IsSecret and the guarded reader; update the three callers.
3. Docs one-liners; regenerate docs/test-cases.md and the README badge.
4. Green gate (lua tests/run.lua, luacheck ., lizard CCN<=15, 1500-line cap); commit `WG-01: ...`.

items.smoke: S-001: in combat (e.g. at a target dummy) get invited to and join a Mythic+ group listed with a teleport you have learned and on cooldown: no Lua error; the chat notice prints in full including the Teleport row; the popup appears after combat; its cooldown note keeps showing (and counts down once out of combat) and the button becomes usable when the cooldown ends.

items.title: RunTest previews without clobbering pendingInfo, and builds nothing while stood down; reloadProfile comment corrected
items.spec: core/WhatGroup.lua RunTest (:1305-1312): never writes self.pendingInfo. When the addon is stood down (not enabled) it prints the chat preview only (ShowNotification with the sample) and builds, shows or withholds no frame (no secure button, no UISpecialFrames proxy, no gateWithheld). When enabled it calls self:ShowNotification(sample) (ShowNotification gains an optional info argument, default self.pendingInfo) and renders the popup through the existing previewInfo/shownInfo() path in modules/Frame.lua as a one-shot preview that is cleared on dismiss (OnHide), so /wg show, the chat details link and launcher Show afterwards render the real capture (or nothing). Add no public surface beyond what that requires (a single NS.FramePreviewOnce(info) or an argument on ShowFrame, whichever is smaller). Test mode's own record is untouched. Comment-only in the same commit: core/WhatGroup.lua:246 reloadProfile reads 'Idempotent; normally a no-op once the account-wide schema stamp is current. Profile-scoped steps walk every stored profile (core/Database.lua).' and the call stays; Database.lua unchanged. Docs that describe the injection are updated: docs/common-tasks.md:251-253, docs/slash-dispatch.md:89, docs/frame.md, docs/data-flow.md, docs/ARCHITECTURE.md where they say RunTest injects pendingInfo; docs/scope.md and docs/module-map.md only if they say the same. Regenerate docs/test-cases.md and README badge.
items.steps:
1. Red first: tests/test_testmode.lua (or test_lifecycle): set a real pendingInfo 'Real Group', RunTest, assert pendingInfo.title is still 'Real Group'; the popup shows the sample; after hiding it, /wg show renders 'Real Group' (`-- red under: RunTest writing pendingInfo`). Rewrite tests/test_lifecycle.lua:485-493: Set('enabled', false); RunTest; assert a chat preview printed, no popup frame built, pendingInfo nil; Set('enabled', true); assert nothing shown (`-- red under: gateWithheld re-show arm`). Update existing test_lifecycle/test_testmode assertions that read the sample from pendingInfo. Run: red.
2. Implement the RunTest/ShowNotification/one-shot preview change.
3. Reword the reloadProfile comment.
4. Docs sync of the injection wording; regenerate docs/test-cases.md and badge.
5. Green gate; commit `WG-02: ...`.

(0/0) && lizard (no function > CCN 15); grep -n 'pendingInfo' core/WhatGroup.lua shows no write inside RunTest; grep -rn 'inject' docs/common-tasks.md docs/slash-dispatch.md docs/frame.md docs/data-flow.md docs/ARCHITECTURE.md has no claim that RunTest sets pendingInfo; grep -n 'Idempotent' core/WhatGroup.lua.
items.smoke: Join (or have captured) a real group, then /wg test notify (and separately the panel Test button): the sample notice and popup appear; close the popup; /wg show and the chat details link open the REAL group, not 'Test Group'. Then /wg disable, press the panel Test button: a chat preview only, no popup; /wg enable: no popup appears unasked.

items.title: Roll the standards reference to the v2.77.x WowAddonStandards opens in this run; docs sync of everything WG-01..WG-06 changed
items.spec: Run /dev-copilot:wow-revendor-standards against the version on WowAddonStandards' feature branch (`head -1 ../WowAddonStandards/standards/STANDARDS.md`, expected v2.77.0). The three-place reference (WhatGroup.toc '## X-Standard', README badge, CLAUDE.md 'Standards compliance') carries no version stamp today: keep it version-free unless the v2.77.0 standard now requires one, in which case add it in all three places. Sweep retired notation, retired file names and unresolvable section references out of the repo (excluding libs/, tests/_kit/ and the frozen docs/audits/, docs/reviews/, docs/automated-tests/ and docs/revendor/ bundles), reading the standard's CHANGELOG between v2.76.1 and the new version (WS-01 moved it to standards/CHANGELOG.md) for renamed sections (toc-file-§5, documentation-§3/§6/§8, events-frames-taint-§8, versioning-git) and re-checking every 'filename-§N' citation resolves. Then /dev-copilot:sync-docs-style pass on README.md, CLAUDE.md, docs/ARCHITECTURE.md (Documentation map, Documented deviations re-check triggers), DEPENDENCIES.md and docs/testing.md so they reflect WG-01..WG-06 (Compat.IsSecret, RunTest one-shot preview, kit 38 Totals, new test count and badge). No version bump, no CHANGELOG release section.

4. Green gate; commit `WG-STD: ...`.
